s0502.literal: On yimao day Mi Ji and others were dispatched as envoys to the kingdom of Sulu.
s0502.idiomatic: On yimao day Mi Ji and others were dispatched as envoys to the kingdom of Sulu.

s0503.literal: On bingchen day King Wang Ju of Koryo said: "Your Majesty ordered your subject to return to his country, yet officials were again appointed to operate the Eastern Campaign branch secretariat.
s0503.idiomatic: On bingchen day King Wang Ju of Koryo said, "Your Majesty ordered your subject to return to his country, yet officials were again appointed to operate the Eastern Campaign branch secretariat.

s0504.literal: Koryo has suffered poor harvests for years; the people lack food, and several hundred persons additionally depend on its soil for sustenance — then the people cannot bear the hardship, and moreover this is not Shizu's old system.
s0504.idiomatic: Koryo has suffered poor harvests for years; the people lack food, and several hundred persons additionally depend on its soil for sustenance — then the people cannot bear the hardship, and moreover this is not Shizu's old system.

s0505.literal: " The Emperor said: "Those who first asked to establish it did so on your word; those who now ask to abolish it also do so on your word — conform to Shizu's old system and quickly dispatch envoys to go abolish it.
s0505.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Those who first asked to establish it did so on your word; those who now ask to abolish it also do so on your word — conform to Shizu's old system and quickly dispatch envoys to go abolish it.

s0506.literal: " Fifth month, on bingyin day Yingde Route was reduced to a prefecture; Privy Council administrator Taruhutai was granted left chancellor by remote appointment.
s0506.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingyin day Yingde Route was reduced to a prefecture; privy council administrator Taruhutai was granted left chancellor by remote appointment.

s0507.literal: On dingmao day censorate officials said: "During Chengzong's reign the National University was built, but to this day it has not been completed; the crown prince requests that the work be finished.
s0507.idiomatic: On dingmao day censorate officials said, "During Chengzong's reign the National University was built, but to this day it has not been completed; the crown prince requests that the work be finished.

s0509.literal: On jisi day Guancheng County suffered heavy hail.
s0509.idiomatic: On jisi day Guancheng County suffered heavy hail.

s0511.literal: On yihai day Privy Council administrator Hanlaher was granted left chancellor by remote appointment.
s0511.idiomatic: On yihai day privy council administrator Hanlaher was granted left chancellor by remote appointment.

s0512.literal: On bingzi day, because princes and Tibetan monks escorting the emperor to the Upper Capital disturbed the people along the route, this was forbidden.
s0512.idiomatic: On bingzi day, because princes and Tibetan monks escorting the emperor to the Upper Capital disturbed the people along the route, this was forbidden.

s0513.literal: The White Lotus Society was banned; its temples were destroyed, and its members were returned to commoners' registry.
s0513.idiomatic: The White Lotus Society was banned; its temples were destroyed, and its members were returned to commoners' registry.

s0514.literal: Censorate officials said: "Recently by imperial order non-urgent labor was halted; now again private residences are being built for various officials.
s0514.idiomatic: Censorate officials said, "Recently by imperial order non-urgent labor was halted; now again private residences are being built for various officials.

s0515.literal: Your subjects consider it fitting to wait until the Onggachatu palace and the temples at Dadu and Wutai are completed, and only then proceed.
s0515.idiomatic: Your subjects consider it fitting to wait until the Onggachatu palace and the temples at Dadu and Wutai are completed, and only then proceed.

s0516.literal: " An order stated: "Except for the residences of Botou and Sanbaonu, all the rest are to be halted.
s0516.idiomatic: An order stated, "Except for the residences of Botou and Sanbaonu, all the rest are to be halted.

s0517.literal: " Right Chancellor Tasibuhua was granted Pillar of State, charged with compiling the national history, and Left Chancellor Qitai Puji was further made crown prince grand tutor.
s0517.idiomatic: Right chancellor Tasibuhua was granted pillar of state, charged with compiling the national history, and left chancellor Qitai Puji was further made crown prince grand tutor.

s0518.literal: On xinsi day central secretariat officials said: "Under the old system, the Privy Council, Censorate, and Bureau of Buddhist Affairs could each select their own officials; all government offices had to have transfers reported through memorial to the central secretariat — strict notice should be issued.
s0518.idiomatic: On xinsi day central secretariat officials said, "Under the old system, the privy council, censorate, and Bureau of Buddhist Affairs could each select their own officials; all government offices had to have transfers reported through memorial to the central secretariat — strict notice should be issued.

s0520.literal: On guiwei day Jinan and Panyang suffered hail.
s0520.idiomatic: On guiwei day Jinan and Panyang suffered hail.

s0521.literal: On jiashen day the Datong Guard Elite Army Command was established; Grand Councillor Chiyin Temur was made commander; more than nine hundred canal transport laborers from the Tonghui River were detached and assigned to it; canal transport affairs continued as before.
s0521.idiomatic: On jiashen day the Datong Guard Elite Army Command was established; grand councillor Chiyin Temur was made commander; more than 900 canal transport laborers from the Tonghui River were detached and assigned to it; canal transport affairs continued as before.

s0522.literal: Weiyuan County suffered drought famine; one month's grain was granted.
s0522.idiomatic: Weiyuan County suffered drought famine; one month's grain was granted.

s0523.literal: Zhending, Daming, and Guangping had insects eating mulberry; Ningxia Prefecture suffered flooding; Jinning and other places had locusts; Dongping, Dongchang, and Yidu had hopper locusts.
s0523.idiomatic: Zhending, Daming, and Guangping had insects eating mulberry; Ningxia Prefecture suffered flooding; Jinning and other places had locusts; Dongping, Dongchang, and Yidu had hopper locusts.

s0524.literal: Sixth month, on jichou day Duke of Bo Sanbaonu was further made recorder of state affairs of military importance and right chancellor of the central secretariat; Duke of Ying, crown prince household administrator, pingzhang of military and state weighty affairs, and minister of revenue Quchu was further made crown prince grand guardian; Left Chancellor Tuotuo was further granted Pillar of State and Grand Marshal; associate administrator by remote appointment and acting crown prince household vice director Daci was further made pingzhang of military and state weighty affairs.
s0524.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jichou day Duke of Bo Sanbaonu was further made recorder of state affairs of military importance and right chancellor of the central secretariat; Duke of Ying, crown prince household administrator, pingzhang of military and state weighty affairs, and minister of revenue Quchu was further made crown prince grand guardian; left chancellor Tuotuo was further granted pillar of state and grand marshal; associate administrator by remote appointment and acting crown prince household vice director Daci was further made pingzhang of military and state weighty affairs.

s0525.literal: On jiawu day the crown prince household Harmonization Office was changed to the Music Bureau, rank 3a.
s0525.idiomatic: On jiawu day the crown prince household Harmonization Office was changed to the Music Bureau, rank 3a.

s0526.literal: On dingyou day Longxi and Ningyuan counties of Gongchang Prefecture suffered an earthquake; in Yunnan's Wusa and Wumeng within three days there were six great earthquakes.
s0526.idiomatic: On dingyou day Longxi and Ningyuan counties of Gongchang Prefecture suffered an earthquake; in Yunnan's Wusa and Wumeng within three days there were six great earthquakes.

s0527.literal: On wuxu day Dadu suffered famine; government granaries were opened to sell grain to the poor at reduced prices; each household was issued a sealed tally; officials were appointed to supervise, to guard against the abuse of unequal distribution.
s0527.idiomatic: On wuxu day Dadu suffered famine; government granaries were opened to sell grain to the poor at reduced prices; each household was issued a sealed tally; officials were appointed to supervise, to guard against the abuse of unequal distribution.

s0528.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Within the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat there is famine — five hundred thirty-five thousand shi of grain for relief, one hundred fifty-four thousand ingots of notes, and forty thousand jin of flour.
s0528.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "Within the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat there is famine — 535,000 shi of grain for relief, 154,000 ingots of notes, and 40,000 jin of flour.

s0529.literal: Also, registered refugee households number one million three hundred thirty-nine thousand fifty and odd; relief grain five hundred thirty-six thousand shi, one hundred ninety-seven thousand ingots of notes, and five thousand salt certificates by conversion value.
s0529.idiomatic: Also, registered refugee households number 1,339,050 and odd; relief grain 536,000 shi, 197,000 ingots of notes, and 5,000 salt certificates by conversion value.

s0530.literal: " Branch secretariat and branch censorate officials were ordered to dispatch officers to oversee on site.
s0530.idiomatic: Branch secretariat and branch censorate officials were ordered to dispatch officers to oversee on site.

s0531.literal: Inner circuits and the Jiang-Huai region suffered great famine; this year's regular levies and summer tax were remitted.
s0531.idiomatic: Inner circuits and the Jiang-Huai region suffered great famine; this year's regular levies and summer tax were remitted.

s0532.literal: Yidu suffered flooding; the people were starving and gathered roots and tree bark for food; this year's corvée was remitted, and relief was still granted from the route's tax revenues and grain from the Zhuwang and Lijin granaries.
s0532.idiomatic: Yidu suffered flooding; the people were starving and gathered roots and tree bark for food; this year's corvée was remitted, and relief was still granted from the route's tax revenues and grain from the Zhuwang and Lijin granaries.

s0533.literal: Yaqmuqur was enfeoffed as Prince of Ding; imperial son-in-law Ashi was enfeoffed as Prince of Chang; both were granted golden seals.
s0533.idiomatic: Yaqmuqur was enfeoffed as Prince of Ding; imperial son-in-law Ashi was enfeoffed as Prince of Chang; both were granted golden seals.

s0534.literal: Minister of Revenue Li Bangning, concurrently grand councillor and head of the Ministry of Revenue, was granted left chancellor by remote appointment.
s0534.idiomatic: Minister of revenue Li Bangning, concurrently grand councillor and head of the Ministry of Revenue, was granted left chancellor by remote appointment.

s0535.literal: On xinchou day confiscated fields and property of Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan were placed under the empress's control; the Jiang-Zhe Financial Affairs General Command and an intendant office were established.
s0535.idiomatic: On xinchou day confiscated fields and property of Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan were placed under the empress's control; the Jiang-Zhe Financial Affairs General Command and an intendant office were established.

s0536.literal: On jiyou day officials of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices were reduced from twenty-seven posts to eight.
s0536.idiomatic: On jiyou day officials of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices were reduced from 27 posts to eight.

s0537.literal: Henan and Shandong suffered great famine; there were instances of fathers eating their sons; confiscated bribe money from the two circuits was used for relief.
s0537.idiomatic: Henan and Shandong suffered great famine; there were instances of fathers eating their sons; confiscated bribe money from the two circuits was used for relief.

s0538.literal: Qitai Puji was further made recorder of state affairs of military importance.
s0538.idiomatic: Qitai Puji was further made recorder of state affairs of military importance.

s0539.literal: That month, Baoding and Zhending had locusts.
s0539.idiomatic: That month, Baoding and Zhending had locusts.

s0540.literal: Seventh month of autumn, on gengshen day a shooting star rose from Gouchen, traveling south, round as a chariot wheel, slightly pointed, passing through Rope Binder and extinguishing.
s0540.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengshen day a shooting star rose from Gouchen, traveling south, round as a chariot wheel, slightly pointed, passing through Rope Binder and extinguishing.

s0541.literal: An edict stated: because annual silver and gold revenues are few, from now on regardless of who it is, anyone who memorializes requesting silver and gold or who has another submit such a memorial on his behalf — all are to be punished as criminals.
s0541.idiomatic: An edict stated: because annual silver and gold revenues are few, from now on regardless of who it is, anyone who memorializes requesting silver and gold or who has another submit such a memorial on his behalf — all are to be punished as criminals.

s0542.literal: Also, officials of branch secretariats, pacification commissions, and the like in various places frequently come to the capital through personal connections; hereafter unless bearing court orders they must not come to the palace.
s0542.idiomatic: Also, officials of branch secretariats, pacification commissions, and the like in various places frequently come to the capital through personal connections; hereafter unless bearing court orders they must not come to the palace.

s0543.literal: Bandits and rebels broke out in Yunnan, Huguang, Henan, and Sichuan; military and civil officials were instructed to devote effort to pacification and governance.
s0543.idiomatic: Bandits and rebels broke out in Yunnan, Huguang, Henan, and Sichuan; military and civil officials were instructed to devote effort to pacification and governance.

s0544.literal: The Guangwu Kangli Guard Elite Army Command was established; central secretariat grand councillor Ashabuhua was made commander-in-chief.
s0544.idiomatic: The Guangwu Kangli Guard Elite Army Command was established; central secretariat grand councillor Ashabuhua was made commander-in-chief.

s0545.literal: On renxu day Prince Khudai requested establishment of a general command office, supervising four intendant offices, to survey approximately more than sixty thousand qing of riverside wasteland within the Henan circuits of Guide and Runing, collecting its annual rent; Henan Province official Gao Xing was ordered to oversee the affair.
s0545.idiomatic: On renxu day Prince Khudai requested establishment of a general command office, supervising four intendant offices, to survey approximately more than 60,000 qing of riverside wasteland within the Henan circuits of Guide and Runing, collecting its annual rent; Henan Province official Gao Xing was ordered to oversee the affair.

s0546.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Riverside land appears and disappears without fixed pattern; when there is a receding sandbank it is claimed as one's own.
s0546.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "Riverside land appears and disappears without fixed pattern; when there is a receding sandbank it is claimed as one's own.

s0547.literal: Previously there was Yimahan, who falsely claimed a provincial commission to survey land; he devoured the people like silkworms, treating all privately owned fields as wasteland; wherever he went there was disturbance.
s0547.idiomatic: Previously there was Yimahan, who falsely claimed a provincial commission to survey land; he devoured the people like silkworms, treating all privately owned fields as wasteland; wherever he went there was disturbance.

s0548.literal: Six hundred persons including commoner Gao Rong complained to the metropolitan secretariat; his courier tallies were revoked; just as his crime was being deliberated, he obtained amnesty; now he has offered the land to the prince.
s0548.idiomatic: 600 persons including commoner Gao Rong complained to the metropolitan secretariat; his courier tallies were revoked; just as his crime was being deliberated, he obtained amnesty; now he has offered the land to the prince.

s0549.literal: Moreover Henan has suffered flooding year after year; people are just now short of food; if the request is granted and government offices established, the harm would not be slight.
s0549.idiomatic: Moreover Henan has suffered flooding year after year; people are just now short of food; if the request is granted and government offices established, the harm would not be slight.

s0550.literal: " The Emperor said: "Why so many words? Stop it and do not proceed!
s0550.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Why so many words? Stop it and do not proceed!

s0551.literal: " Hunting with the eagle offices was forbidden from harassing the people by hunting freely in Datong, Longxing, and other places.
s0551.idiomatic: Hunting with the eagle offices was forbidden from harassing the people by hunting freely in Datong, Longxing, and other places.

s0552.literal: A hawking platform was built in the marshes of Huozhou; one thousand five hundred soldiers were mobilized to assist the labor.
s0552.idiomatic: A hawking platform was built in the marshes of Huozhou; 1,500 soldiers were mobilized to assist the labor.

s0554.literal: The Central Capital Resident Commission, concurrently the Kaining Route general administration, was established.
s0554.idiomatic: The Central Capital Resident Commission, concurrently the Kaining Route general administration, was established.

s0555.literal: On bingyin day Xintai County of Tai'an Prefecture was re-established.
s0555.idiomatic: On bingyin day Xintai County of Tai'an Prefecture was re-established.

s0556.literal: On xinmao day Jining suffered great flooding entering the city; an edict dispatched officials to grant five thousand ingots of notes for relief.
s0556.idiomatic: On xinmao day Jining suffered great flooding entering the city; an edict dispatched officials to grant 5,000 ingots of notes for relief.

s0557.literal: On jisi day Zhending suffered torrential rain; water overflowed, entering through the south gate and reaching down to Gaocheng; one hundred seventy-seven persons drowned; ten thousand seven hundred shi of grain were issued for relief.
s0557.idiomatic: On jisi day Zhending suffered torrential rain; water overflowed, entering through the south gate and reaching down to Gaocheng; 177 persons drowned; 10,700 shi of grain were issued for relief.

s0558.literal: On xinwei day the Imperial Incense Bureau was established, rank 5a.
s0558.idiomatic: On xinwei day the Imperial Incense Bureau was established, rank 5a.

s0559.literal: On renshen day Venus transgressed the Left Enforcer.
s0559.idiomatic: On renshen day Venus transgressed the Left Enforcer.

s0560.literal: Xiangshan was further made crown prince grand tutor.
s0560.idiomatic: Xiangshan was further made crown prince grand tutor.

s0561.literal: Tachar and nine others were dispatched as envoys to Prince Kuancha,
s0561.idiomatic: Tachar and nine others were dispatched as envoys to Prince Kuancha,

s0562.literal: Yuelu and twelve others as envoys to Prince Tuotuo.
s0562.idiomatic: Yuelu and twelve others as envoys to Prince Tuotuo.

s0563.literal: On guiyou day an edict instructed the kingdom of Annam: "Our state, by military achievement settled the realm, by civil virtue embraced distant peoples — We turn affectionately to Annam: from your forefathers your ancestors and fathers have generation after generation maintained tribute, and We greatly commend this.
s0563.idiomatic: On guiyou day an edict instructed the kingdom of Annam, "Our state, by military achievement settled the realm, by civil virtue embraced distant peoples — We turn affectionately to Annam: from your forefathers your ancestors and fathers have generation after generation maintained tribute, and We greatly commend this.

s0564.literal: Recently the late emperor passed away; We were then marshaling troops in the north, and were acclaimed by imperial clansmen, princes, noble kin, and founding meritorious officials — holding that We are Shizu's legitimate grandson, Yuzong's orthodox line; the imperial fiefs show loyalty abroad, officials and people look to Us below — the hearts of all agree, and the imperial regalia has its rightful destination.
s0564.idiomatic: Recently the late emperor passed away; We were then marshaling troops in the north, and were acclaimed by imperial clansmen, princes, noble kin, and founding meritorious officials — holding that We are Shizu's legitimate grandson, Yuzong's orthodox line; the imperial fiefs show loyalty abroad, officials and people look to Us below — the hearts of all agree, and the imperial regalia has its rightful destination.

s0565.literal: We deferentially accede to popular sentiment: on the twenty-first day of the fifth month of the eleventh year of Dade We ascended the throne at the Upper Capital.
s0565.idiomatic: We deferentially accede to popular sentiment: on the twenty-first day of the fifth month of the eleventh year of Dade We ascended the throne at the Upper Capital.

s0566.literal: Now We dispatch Junior Palace Grandee and Minister of Rites Aligui, Gentleman for Court Appearances and Vice Minister of Personnel Li Jing, and Gentleman of the Court Assembly and Vice Minister of War Gao Fuli to convey Our instruction.
s0566.idiomatic: Now We dispatch junior palace grandee and minister of rites Aligui, gentleman for court appearances and vice minister of personnel Li Jing, and gentleman of the court assembly and vice minister of war Gao Fuli to convey Our instruction.

s0567.literal: Continue to regard Us with equal benevolence, further strengthen the sincerity of serving the great power, and bring tranquility to your state, to accord with Our wish.
s0567.idiomatic: Continue to regard Us with equal benevolence, further strengthen the sincerity of serving the great power, and bring tranquility to your state, to accord with Our wish.

s0568.literal: " Guan Zhousijian was also made vice minister of rites and Duorji vice minister of war as envoys to Burma.
s0568.idiomatic: Guan Zhousijian was also made vice minister of rites and Duorji vice minister of war as envoys to Burma.

s0569.literal: Tuolibuhua and twenty others were dispatched as envoys to Prince Herbandar.
s0569.idiomatic: Tuolibuhua and twenty others were dispatched as envoys to Prince Herbandar.

s0570.literal: The liquor ban at the Upper Capital was relaxed.
s0570.idiomatic: The liquor ban at the Upper Capital was relaxed.

s0571.literal: On renwu day crown prince deliberation officer was established, rank 5a.
s0571.idiomatic: On renwu day crown prince deliberation officer was established, rank 5a.

s0572.literal: Naimandai was enfeoffed as Prince of Shou.
s0572.idiomatic: Naimandai was enfeoffed as Prince of Shou.

s0573.literal: On guiwei day privy council officials said: "Under Shizu there were six privy council ministers; under Chengzong this increased to thirteen.
s0573.idiomatic: On guiwei day privy council officials said, "Under Shizu there were six privy council ministers; under Chengzong this increased to 13.

s0574.literal: Now thirty-two persons hold office; we request they be reduced.
s0574.idiomatic: Now 32 persons hold office; we request they be reduced.

s0575.literal: " An edict dismissed Tasidai and eleven others.
s0575.idiomatic: An edict dismissed Tasidai and 11 others.

s0576.literal: On jiashen day Grand Preceptor and Prince of Qiyang Yuechachar requested establishment of a princely tutor; central secretariat officials said that for non-imperial-clan princes there is no precedent for appointing tutors — not permitted.
s0576.idiomatic: On jiashen day grand preceptor and Prince of Qiyang Yuechachar requested establishment of a princely tutor; central secretariat officials said that for non-imperial-clan princes there is no precedent for appointing tutors — not permitted.

s0577.literal: On yiyou day tiger keeper Cherkesh was made surveillance censor.
s0577.idiomatic: On yiyou day tiger keeper Cherkesh was made surveillance censor.

s0578.literal: That month, Left Chancellor Tasibuhua was made right chancellor of the central secretariat; Grand Guardian Qitai Puji was made left chancellor of the central secretariat; all internal and external matters great and small were to be disposed by the central secretariat; princes, princesses, imperial sons-in-law, powerful persons, and the like must not interfere and obstruct; close attendant officials and all internal and external yamens must not bypass channels in reporting to the throne.
s0578.idiomatic: That month, left chancellor Tasibuhua was made right chancellor of the central secretariat; grand guardian Qitai Puji was made left chancellor of the central secretariat; all internal and external matters great and small were to be disposed by the central secretariat; princes, princesses, imperial sons-in-law, powerful persons, and the like must not interfere and obstruct; close attendant officials and all internal and external yamens must not bypass channels in reporting to the throne.

s0579.literal: Officials of branch secretariats, pacification commissions, and other yamens outside the capital in various places, unless bearing imperial edict together with written document from the central secretariat, must not on their own leave their posts, travel by relay to the capital, and manage private affairs.
s0579.idiomatic: Officials of branch secretariats, pacification commissions, and other yamens outside the capital in various places, unless bearing imperial edict together with written document from the central secretariat, must not on their own leave their posts, travel by relay to the capital, and manage private affairs.

s0580.literal: Jiangnan and Jiangbei suffered flooding, drought, and famine; where envoys had already been dispatched for relief, corvée levies and official taxes of the first year of Zhida were all concurrently remitted.
s0580.idiomatic: Jiangnan and Jiangbei suffered flooding, drought, and famine; where envoys had already been dispatched for relief, corvée levies and official taxes of the first year of Zhida were all concurrently remitted.

s0581.literal: Eighth month, on wuzi day Daning suffered hail.
s0581.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuzi day Daning suffered hail.

s0582.literal: On bingshen day censorate officials said: "By imperial order Surveillance Censor Saduding was summoned to the Upper Capital.
s0582.idiomatic: On bingshen day censorate officials said, "By imperial order surveillance censor Saduding was summoned to the Upper Capital.

s0583.literal: From Shizu and Chengzong down to Your Majesty there have repeatedly been clear edicts: surveillance censors are the court's eyes and ears — when officials at home and abroad commit wrongdoing and breach the law, or are derelict in duty, they may impeach; during the conduct of business others must not be involved.
s0583.idiomatic: From Shizu and Chengzong down to Your Majesty there have repeatedly been clear edicts: surveillance censors are the court's eyes and ears — when officials at home and abroad commit wrongdoing and breach the law, or are derelict in duty, they may impeach; during the conduct of business others must not be involved.

s0584.literal: Recently at the interrogation of Minister of Justice Ulasha for bribery, We received the imperial voice's commendation; all censors were granted rewards; the censorate's authority was further strengthened.
s0584.idiomatic: Recently at the interrogation of minister of justice Ulasha for bribery, We received the imperial voice's commendation; all censors were granted rewards; the censorate's authority was further strengthened.

s0585.literal: Now Saduding has been seized; his colleagues are all fearful; what is at stake is no small matter — we beg that this order be suspended and the censorate's disciplinary regulations declared, that others must not be involved.
s0585.idiomatic: Now Saduding has been seized; his colleagues are all fearful; what is at stake is no small matter — we beg that this order be suspended and the censorate's disciplinary regulations declared, that others must not be involved.

s0587.literal: On xinchou day, because the Central Capital palace was completed, officials who had labored were rewarded; Minister of Works Heima and those below were all promoted two grades; Tal'er was granted two hundred fifty taels of silver; Associate Administrator Chana, Communications Commissioner Talichi, Associate Resident Administrator Xiao Zhen, and Vice Minister of Works Dashman were granted two hundred taels of gold and one thousand four hundred taels of silver; soldiers two hundred taels of gold and eight hundred taels of silver; those who died from falling timber and stone or from illness were granted notes in varying amounts.
s0587.idiomatic: On xinchou day, because the Central Capital palace was completed, officials who had labored were rewarded; minister of works Heima and those below were all promoted two grades; Tal'er was granted 250 taels of silver; associate administrator Chana, communications commissioner Talichi, associate resident administrator Xiao Zhen, and vice minister of works Dashman were granted 200 taels of gold and 1,400 taels of silver; soldiers 200 taels of gold and 800 taels of silver; those who died from falling timber and stone or from illness were granted notes in varying amounts.

s0588.literal: On guimao day Right Vice Chancellor and head of the Directorate of Palace Construction Lu Tianlin was further made Grand Preceptor.
s0588.idiomatic: On guimao day right vice chancellor and head of the Directorate of Palace Construction Lu Tianlin was further made grand preceptor.

s0589.literal: On wushen day the Central Capital Myriad Treasuries Office was established.
s0589.idiomatic: On wushen day the Central Capital Myriad Treasuries Office was established.

s0590.literal: Ningxia established a River Works Office, fifth rank, two posts; two monks were additionally appointed to it.
s0590.idiomatic: Ningxia established a River Works Office, fifth rank, two posts; two monks were additionally appointed to it.

s0591.literal: Botou was specially appointed Grand Preceptor.
s0591.idiomatic: Botou was specially appointed grand preceptor.

s0592.literal: Prince Tuohuan was granted two hundred taels of gold, two thousand five hundred taels of silver, and two thousand ingots of notes; Alibuhua one hundred taels of gold, one thousand taels of silver, and one thousand ingots of notes.
s0592.idiomatic: Prince Tuohuan was granted 200 taels of gold, 2,500 taels of silver, and 2,000 ingots of notes; Alibuhua 100 taels of gold, 1,000 taels of silver, and 1,000 ingots of notes.

s0593.literal: On jiyou day Datong suffered killing frost that destroyed the grain.
s0593.idiomatic: On jiyou day Datong suffered killing frost that destroyed the grain.

s0594.literal: On jiayin day Li Bangning, because the incense hall was completed, was granted fifty taels of gold and four hundred fifty taels of silver.
s0594.idiomatic: On jiayin day Li Bangning, because the incense hall was completed, was granted 50 taels of gold and 450 taels of silver.

s0595.literal: On yimao day central secretariat officials said: "The outer censorate, branch secretariats, and various persons responding to edicts to speak on affairs — we dare not one by one trouble the imperial ear.
s0595.idiomatic: On yimao day central secretariat officials said, "The outer censorate, branch secretariats, and various persons responding to edicts to speak on affairs — we dare not one by one trouble the imperial ear.

s0596.literal: We request that court officials be assembled to discuss, selecting those most pertinent to affairs — small matters then be executed at once, large matters reported upward.
s0596.idiomatic: We request that court officials be assembled to discuss, selecting those most pertinent to affairs — small matters then be executed at once, large matters reported upward.

s0599.literal: Ninth month, on bingchen day, because inner circuits' harvests failed, persons and horses of various departments entering the capital were reduced by five tenths.
s0599.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingchen day, because inner circuits' harvests failed, persons and horses of various departments entering the capital were reduced by five tenths.

s0600.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Between summer and autumn Gongchang suffered an earthquake; Guide violent wind and rain; Tai'an, Jining, and Zhending great flooding — dwellings were swept away, and both humans and livestock alike suffered the disaster.
s0600.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "Between summer and autumn Gongchang suffered an earthquake; Guide violent wind and rain; Tai'an, Jining, and Zhending great flooding — dwellings were swept away, and both humans and livestock alike suffered the disaster.
